summary.zh: 摸清多包仓库的依赖图与构建影响范围
summary.en: Map packages and dependencies to see what a change affects.

description.zh: 解析 Turborepo、Nx、pnpm workspace、Lerna 仓库的包结构与依赖关系，说明改一处会牵动哪些构建和发布，并指导增量构建、远程缓存和从多仓库合并。适合接手大型仓库或调整构建配置时使用。
description.en: Parses Turborepo, Nx, pnpm workspace and Lerna layouts to show the package graph and which builds and releases a change touches. Also covers affected-only builds, remote caching and many-repos-to-one moves. Best when joining a large repo.
